title: Kuldra Duo World Record (8:31) | Dragonwilds 1.0 release
author: Special_Atks
description: In this video Yabbie and I beat Kuldra in the fastest time i've seen anyone kill the boss yet across all platforms. The time was 8 minutes 31 seconds if you count it when the heart explodes. Alternatively, it was 8 minutes 46 seconds if you count it when the cutscene drops. Dragonwilds 1.0 release was an amazing job by Jaggex, and I look forward to what's coming next. Watch me live on Twitch daily using the link here. https://www.twitch.tv/special_atks

comments.text: Nice man! i just did 9:49 when the heart explodes solo. probably only able to shave 10ish seconds off. was pretty flawless imo. First phase was 1:49 including teleport time for me as well

comments.author: @SpecialAtks
comments.text: Appreciate it! I wanna say this was close to our tenth run lol. Was trying to beat the fastest we saw which was a tiny bit over 10. The dragon items really help! Sub 10 is zooooming.  We did ours on normal since that’s what the early access world was set on. Idk if they will patch it, but if you run far enough when extraction point unlocks you can yeet off a cliff and keep teleporting to the next extraction through Zilyana bypassing all the puzzles.
